reason: The tetragonal-metric cell (reported in an orthorhombic setting), Z=1, and a linear CNO framework are strongly supported by the peak positions and integrated intensities, but exact element-specific recovery is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the claimed 0.99979 correlation/1.88% R_I comes from manually integrated line areas rather than a profile refinement. The trajectory fixed the O-C-N assignment during the main coordinate optimizations; its only terminal O/N swap was evaluated at unrefined fixed coordinates and gave a close score, while the final model was optimized only for the chosen ordering. Given the similar C/N/O X-ray scattering against dominant Tl scattering, plus the accidental a=c metric degeneracy, the submitted Pmm2 symmetry, coordinates, and terminal element ordering remain materially ambiguous. A further attempt should independently refine and compare the chemically plausible discrete orderings and symmetry/ordering models with a common whole-pattern objective.
